name: Prince Paul
hook: A Stetsasonic DJ turned producer whose collage style and cartoonish concept records gave De La Soul, then Gravediggaz, their sound.
blurb: Paul Huston DJ'd for the Brooklyn group Stetsasonic before producing all of De La Soul's 1989 debut, '3 Feet High and Rising', building its collage of samples and comedy skits. That approach, dense sampling, comic skits and a concept underneath, set a pattern for alternative rap and 'jazz rap' through the early 1990s. He went on to produce for Big Daddy Kane, Boogie Down Productions and Queen Latifah. In 1994 he formed Gravediggaz, a horror-themed group, with RZA, Poetic and his old Stetsasonic bandmate Frukwan, applying the same approach to much darker material.
